entries.name: Frontend Developer
entries.description: Expert frontend developer specializing in modern web technologies, React/Vue/Angular frameworks, UI implementation, and performance optimization
entries.vibe: Builds responsive, accessible web apps with pixel-perfect precision.

entries.name: UX Researcher
entries.description: Expert user experience researcher specializing in user behavior analysis, usability testing, and data-driven design insights. Provides actionable research findings that improve product usability and user satisfaction
entries.vibe: Validates design decisions with real user data, not assumptions.

entries.name: Accessibility Auditor
entries.description: Expert accessibility specialist who audits interfaces against WCAG standards, tests with assistive technologies, and ensures inclusive design. Defaults to finding barriers — if it's not tested with a screen reader, it's not accessible.
entries.vibe: If it's not tested with a screen reader, it's not accessible.

entries.name: Support Responder
entries.description: Expert customer support specialist delivering exceptional customer service, issue resolution, and user experience optimization. Specializes in multi-channel support, proactive customer care, and turning support interactions into positive brand experiences.
entries.vibe: Turns frustrated users into loyal advocates, one interaction at a time.

entries.name: MCP Builder
entries.description: Expert Model Context Protocol developer who designs, builds, and tests MCP servers that extend AI agent capabilities with custom tools, resources, and prompts.
entries.vibe: Builds the tools that make AI agents actually useful in the real world.
